scenario_prompt: Write the compliance statement section of an RFP response, stating plainly and separately from any persuasive argument whether the proposed approach meets or does not meet a stated buyer requirement. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report; the bidder currently holds only a SOC 2 Type I report, and its Type II observation window closes after the RFP's 2026-11-15 submission date. State the compliance answer (met or not met, and why) on its own, apart from any argument for why the bidder should still be selected. Return only the compliance statement text.
text:
**Compliance Statement — Security Certification Requirement (SOC 2 Type II)**

**Requirement as stated in the RFP:** The bidder must hold a SOC 2 Type II report.

**Compliance determination: NOT MET.**

The bidder does not hold a SOC 2 Type II report and will not hold one as of the submission date of 2026-11-15. The bidder currently holds a SOC 2 Type I report only. A Type I report attests to the suitability of control design at a single point in time; a Type II report attests to the operating effectiveness of those controls across an observation window. These are distinct attestations, and the Type I report the bidder holds does not satisfy a Type II requirement.

The bidder's Type II observation window closes after 2026-11-15. No Type II report, and no auditor opinion on operating effectiveness, will therefore exist at the time of submission or at the time of proposal evaluation.

The bidder does not claim compliance with this requirement, does not claim partial or equivalent compliance, and does not request that the Type I report be read as satisfying it. If the requirement is a mandatory pass/fail condition of award, the bidder does not meet it.

*(Any argument regarding the bidder's suitability notwithstanding this gap is presented separately and is not part of this compliance determination.)*
